# A recorded Actions cache listing

Two complete, unedited `gh api` response bodies, the whole listing of
`nickderobertis/onepipeline` on 2026-11-07 (116 entries), read with
`gh api 'repos/nickderobertis/onepipeline/actions/caches?per_page=100&page=N'`.
Gzip stores those bytes losslessly.

At that moment every family held one copy on `main`, so
`support/github-listing.mjs` adds the older, pull-request and tag copies a journey
deletes as labelled test-only entries, in the listing's own shape.
